{{Quote|Must relax&hellip;reach out with my mind&hellip;reach inside&hellip;through the pain&hellip;to touch the Force! Knit bones&hellip;mend flesh&hellip;renew!|Ki-Adi-Mundi|<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 9">[[Star Wars (1998) 9|''Star Wars'' (1998) 9]]</ref>}}
'''Healing''' through the use of '''meditation''' was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] technique where one [[Meditation/Legends|meditated]] while repairing injuries to their body. [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] used this technique to accelerate healing to his broken arm, sustained after a [[Bantha-II cargo skiff/Legends|Bantha-II cargo skiff]] crash on the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
